title: SBNO : Schr\"odinger Bridge Neural Operator for the Forward and Inverse Problems under Missing Information
abstract: arXiv:2610.13317v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Partial differential equation (PDE) surrogate modeling often relies on either dense observations or access to governing equations/physics constraints. In practice, observations can be sparse and partial, and the underlying physics may be partially specified or unavailable. We introduce SBNO, an equation-free paired-data diffusion bridge matching framework that learns conditional operators for both forward and inverse PDE problems under partial observations. SBNO uses diffusion Schr\"odinger bridge matching to learn a pair of time-dependent drifts from a mask-aware endpoint coupling that preserves empirical input-solution pairing during training and supports both PDE-task directions within a single framework. At inference time, SBNO produces a deterministic point reconstruction by integrating the probability-flow ODE constructed from the learned drift pair, without inference-time observation or PDE guidance-weight tuning. translated_title: SBNO：面向信息缺失场景下正问题与逆问题的薛定谔桥神经算子
translated_abstract: 偏微分方程（PDE）代理建模通常依赖于稠密的观测数据，或者可以获取控制方程及物理约束。而在实际应用中，观测往往是稀疏且不完整的，底层物理机理也可能仅被部分给定或完全不可得。我们提出了SBNO，这是一个免方程的、基于成对数据的扩散桥匹配框架，能够在部分观测条件下为PDE的正问题和逆问题学习条件算子。SBNO利用扩散薛定谔桥匹配，从一种掩码感知的端点耦合中学习一对时间依赖的漂移项，该耦合在训练过程中保留了经验上的输入-解配对关系，并在单一框架内同时支持两种PDE任务方向。在推理阶段，SBNO通过积分由学习到的漂移对构建的概率流常微分方程（ODE），生成确定性的点重建结果，无需在推理时进行观测引导或PDE引导权重的调节。在五个PDE基准测试上（原文在此处截断）……
tldr: SBNO提出了一种免方程的薛定谔桥匹配神经算子框架，在观测稀疏且物理信息部分缺失的情况下，以单一模型同时解决PDE的正问题与逆问题。
en_tdlr: SBNO is an equation-free Schrödinger bridge matching neural operator framework that solves both forward and inverse PDE problems under sparse, partial observations within a single unified model.
